timing: Retrospective saved-row audit. Source files and README were read before the plan; first lines of two saved databases were inspected. The plan freezes all eight filenames, recurrence interpretations, controls and complete-row recount before further saved-row inspection. This is not a preregistered historical search.
source_license: No license found at pinned revision; original scripts and corpus are external Git prerequisites, not bundled.
source_execution: The pinned __main__ calls only db_high_autokey_-p with no inversion. Seven other committed DB files have no active call in this revision; the variant interpretation comes from the adjacent source comment and filename, then is checked against every saved score.
transform: For each candidate, first take the first 16 occurrences of source index 0; inverted files instead locate index 28 in the original, then map every rune index c to 28-c. Cut at the 17th occurrence if present, remove saved selected occurrences, and decode p_i=(y_i +/- f(p_(i-1))) mod29; f is GP prime or index, primer 0..28. The keylen=0 row is scored with primer1 by source find_best_solution; all other rows use their keylen field as primer. Score normalized 29xIoC of the entire decoded prefix (source IC_w_keylen with keylen1).

variant_bounds.interrupt_rune: source index0, or source index28 before inversion

known_control.criteria: Source-shaped removal of three inserted interrupt runes, complete 96-rune known text recovery, source-class parity for score and interruption position mapping. A separate fixed-skip primer ranking is descriptive, not required for recovery.

target_criterion: Recount every noncomment saved row in eight files to within source's five-decimal score print precision; distinguish called -p from seven uncalled saved variants. Report maxima as descriptive and never infer a fresh 2^16 search was run.
